title: Tilla's Tweaks
description: A collection of changes aimed to "Fix" or "Enhance" various aspects of the game with vanilla in mind.
body:
So I historically have a huge problem with vanilla. I have been modding for nearly as long as I have bene playing. This pack is ongoing attempt to fix or correct various things I saw wrong with vanilla. I have decided to upload this publicly and I will do my best to document all the changes I make!

[I also suggest checking out my tweak for stair recipes!](https://modrinth.com/datapack/fixed-stairs-recipe) (I would include it here but its already uploaded seperately.)

**ADDITIONS**
- Clay -> Bricks in Blasting Furnace
- Rotten Flesh -> Leather Smoking & Smelting (Remove Smelt?)
- String + Paper -> Nametag, Maybe tweak and add nuggets?
- Wool -> String
- Smelt or Blast Ore Block -> Metal Block
- Mass Craft Chest  via Logs
- Mass Craft Sticks via Logs
- Chainmail Recipe
- Bell Recipe
- Bee Nest Recipe
- Horse Armor Recipes
- Recycle Tools, Armor & Weapons with Stonecutter (Blame mojang for hardcoding furnaces can only produce ONE item)


**EDITS**
- Saddle Recipe
- Removed Nuggets from melting weapons and tools
- Edited Leather Horse Armor Recipe
- Replaced Iron in Rail Recipes with copper (Personal preference and copper is more plentiful)
- Wart blocks from nether fungus trees can now be replaced by moss, making them a sustainable source of dirt by extension
- Andesite, Diorite, Granite, Tuff added to "Stone crafting materials" tag & "Stone tool materials" tag
- Hanging Signs now accept any chain in "Minecraft:chains" tag and will accept stripped logs and stripped wood (They're basically the same thing)

**Loot Tables** 
- Skeletons can now drop their heads, similar mechanics to wither skeletons but a bit higher chance
- Adult Goats now drop Mutton when killed, as opposed to nothing.
- Pigs now provide more meat on AVERAGE, and can drop leather (They got skin to make leather and lacked anything unique. So I made them provide more materials for their lack of anything exclusive)


**Archeology Loot Changes** (Warrented its own section)

**_Removed the following from Archeology Loot due to "WTF Why?"_**
- Wooden Hoe
- Coal
- Wheat
- Clay
- Various Dyes
- String
- Crop Seeds
- Dead Bush
- Stick
- suspicious stew
- tnt
- Gunpowder
- Replaced Colored Candles with uncolored
- various stained glass pains
- Hanging signs
- Leads
- Bricks

**_Added to Various Archeology Loot because "More Fitting/Rewarding"_**

- **Cold Oceans:** Iron Nugget, Copper Nugget, Compass, Spyglass, Ender Pearl
- **Warm Oceans:** Nautilus Shell, Turtle Scute, Spyglass, Compass, Iron Nugget, Copper nugget
- **Trail Ruins (common):** Spyglass, Compass, Iron Nugget, Copper Nugget, Bone, Lapis Lazuli, Glass Bottle, Normal Candle, All Glazed Terracottas
- **Desert Well:** Spyglass, Compass, Glass BOttle, Bucket, Bone, Skeleton SKull
- **Desert Pyramid:** Gold Ingot, Skeleton Skull
